name: Scotts Bluff County, NE
findings: Scotts Bluff County has 165 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Scotts Bluff County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Scotts Bluff County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
